bio: Thomas left Dorset at nineteen with a trunk of tools and a letter of introduction to a foundry in Rochester. He never returned to England, but he kept the Bridport harbour on a tin lid above his forge for the rest of his life.
funFacts: Kept a tin lid painted with Bridport harbour above his forge for fifty years.

media.title: Thomas Hartwell's forge on Lyell Avenue, about 1905.
